subject: Recap + MAP draft: technical evaluation milestone (benchmark specs & owners)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ara Khan <ara@synapsecare.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@synapsecare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + MAP draft: technical evaluation milestone (benchmark specs & owners)

Hi Ara / Marcus —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to see the SynapseCare use case and the target SLA for live triage. Per our discussion, I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.2.xlsx) and a short benchmark spec (bench_spec_v1.md). Below is a concise draft of the Technical Evaluation milestone we discussed so we can lock owners and timelines.

Technical evaluation (MAP milestone) — draft details
- Goal: Verify model & serving configuration meets SynapseCare production criteria for entity extraction and triage prompts.
- Success criteria (pass/fail gating):
  • Entity extraction F1 >= 0.90 on SynapseCare labeled holdout (N=5k annotated notes)
  • Intent-class recall >= 0.93 for triage-critical intents
  • Generation latency: p95 <= 150ms for 512-token generation on Dedicated capacity (single-request, cold KV)
  • Cost: inference token cost target < $35 / 1M tokens at sustained QPS baseline (estimate)
  • No critical hallucination patterns on 3 targeted prompt templates (manual QA)
- Shortlist of model variants to evaluate (initial):
  1) Llama-2-70B (8-bit / quantized) — for highest accuracy baseline
  2) Mistral-Instruct-34B (4-bit) — balance of latency/cost
  3) Falcon-40B-Instruct (8-bit) — lower-cost baseline
  4) Redwood-30B-q (our quantized variant) — production-config candidate (if available)
- Benchmark methodology highlights:
  • Test harness: Redwood Console + reproducible runner (we'll provide a Scripted harness and metrics dashboard)
  • Datasets: SynapseCare will provide 5k labeled notes + 1k blind evaluation set; Redwood will augment with anonymized public clinical set for calibration
  • Metrics: token latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), cost per 1M tokens, F1/precision/recall for extraction, qualitative hallucination tags

Proposed owners and deadlines
- SynapseCare technical lead: Ara Khan (confirm) — provide labeled eval set by 2026-12-08
- Redwood engineering: Laura Bennett — bench harness, runner, and console dashboard (deliverable: bench run template) by 2026-12-15
- Redwood solutions: Priyom Das — test plan, run coordination, and evaluation readout (deliverable: run checklist + readout slide deck) by 2026-12-20
- Decision milestone / MAP target close: 2027-01-15 (target for go/no-go on Dedicated pilot)

Dependencies / risks
- Data access & privacy: need SynapseCare anonymized dataset and confirmation on what can be used in Redwood test environments (redaction/PII rules)
- SLA-representative load: we will need a short traffic profile to replicate burst behavior for p95 measurement
- Contracting: Dedicated capacity terms need to be agreed in parallel — procurement/finance coordination required

Next steps I propose:
1) Ara: confirm dataset owner + delivery date (2026-12-08) and technical point-of-contact for test access.
2) Redwood (Laura/Priyom): create bench runner and share instructions + sample outputs in Drive by 2026-12-15.
3) Joint sync: 60-minute technical kickoff on 2026-12-16 to align on test harness and pass/fail gating.

I've attached the MAP draft and the benchmark spec. Please flag anything missing or unrealistic in the gating criteria and confirm the owners/dates above.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), bench_spec_v1.md (benchmark spec), sample-dataset-manifest.csv (requested manifest template)

From: Ara Khan <ara@synapsecare.com>

Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@synapsecare.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft: technical evaluation milestone (benchmark specs & owners)

Thanks Rishi — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Confirmed dataset & POC contacts
- I'll own dataset delivery (Ara Khan) and will work with our data ops to produce the anonymized 5k labeled notes. ETA: 2026-12-07 (we'll try to move earlier).
- Technical contact for infra access during runs: Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@synapsecare.com).

2) Success criteria prioritization
- The entity F1 target of 0.90 is acceptable as a stretch goal. If a model variant hits >=0.88 with much better latency/cost, we should include that in the readout as a candidate.
- For cost, SynapseCare budget team is more comfortable with a target closer to $25 / 1M tokens; can Redwood provide an estimated cost matrix per model variant so we can set realistic procurement expectations?

3) One additional dependency: certification needs — our compliance team wants to see audit logs and key management details for any Dedicated pilot. Can Redwood include a short appendix describing log retention and KMS integration?

We'll confirm the kickoff time once you send a calendar invite.

— Ara
Director, Applied ML — SynapseCare

Adding a few technical clarifications / proposed test plan items so expectations are set correctly: 

Hi all —

Quick notes:
- Latency target (p95 <= 150ms) is achievable but depends on sequence length and KV cache state. Our bench runs will include two modalities: cold-start (empty KV, single request) and hot-run (cached prefix for interactive sessions). We'll report both.
- For cost estimates: I will run an initial cost model for the four shortlisted variants and export a cost-by-QPS table (expected $/1M tokens at baseline QPS 10, and at QPS 50). Expect this by 2026-12-10.
- Test harness: plan to deliver a Dockerized runner + CI job that runs the canonical evaluation set and uploads results to the Redwood Console. Priyom will coordinate the run windows with SynapseCare.

Proposed bench schedule (tight):
- 2026-12-08: SynapseCare delivers anonymized eval set + access instructions
- 2026-12-11 — 12: dry-run on small subset to validate harness
- 2026-12-13 — 14: full benchmark runs for all shortlisted variants (overnight to capture burst profile)
- 2026-12-17: internal readout and prep of joint results deck

I'll also include a short appendix on audit logs and KMS integration for the compliance ask; Neha, can you add the KMS+audit paragraph and a one-page summary?

Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference
